name: app-black-lime-information-architecture-tree
title: Black and Lime Information Architecture Tree
whatItIs: A black page with a short intro paragraph and a left-to-right tree: a glowing lime Splash Screen node branching into five dark pill sections (Home, Rooms, Security, Statistics, Profile) and their sub-screens that fade out to the right.
whatItMeans: The single glowing lime node marks the entry point, and dark grey pills stay quiet. Fading depth communicates 'more inside' without listing everything.
techniques: One lit node with a soft glow as the starting point
Thin lime connector with a small light dot at the fork
App icon at far left as the root

vocabulary.definition: How an app's content and screens are organised.
The starting item from which a tree branches.
Reducing opacity for deeper levels of a hierarchy.
